name: marketingskills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the marketingskills capability.

prompts.name: copywriting_generate
prompts.template: Create persuasive marketing copy for a product that focuses on {product_features} targeting {audience} with the goal of {campaign_objective}.
prompts.use_case: Generating high-conversion marketing copy for digital campaigns

prompts.name: seo_optimization
prompts.template: Analyze the following content for SEO improvements targeting keywords: {keywords}. Suggest optimizations.
prompts.use_case: Optimizing website or content SEO to improve search rankings

prompts.name: analytics_insights
prompts.template: Provide an analytics summary and growth recommendations based on the following marketing data: {marketing_data}.
prompts.use_case: Analyzing campaign data to produce actionable growth strategies

prompts.name: cro_testing_plan
prompts.template: Generate a CRO testing plan to improve conversion rate for the campaign focused on {campaign_objective}.
prompts.use_case: Automating marketing tasks for AI-driven agents using Claude Code
